source: In the S bus, in the rush hour. A chap of about 26, felt hat with a cord instead of a ribbon, neck too long, as if someone’s been having a tug-of-war with it. People getting off. The chap in question gets annoyed with one of the men standing next to him. He accuses him of jostling him every time anyone goes past. A snivelling tone which is meant to be aggressive. When he sees a vacant seat he throws himself on to it. Two hours later, I meet him in the Cour de Rome, in front of the gare Saint-Lazare. He’s with a friend who’s saying: "You ought to get an extra button put on your overcoat." He shows him where (at the lapels) and why.

gens.text: At the bustling border security checkpoint, amidst the labyrinthine queues and towering barriers, passengers divested their belongings onto trays, preparing to pass through the relentless scanners and metal detectors. A vigilant officer, with a practiced hand, pointed towards the designated area, signaling for a meticulous search. Amidst the humdrum of the security procedures, one traveler was singled out, instructed to produce identification and submit to a thorough pat-down with a wand. The atmosphere was governed by stringent control: clear instructions were posted, along with official signage, and the demeanor of the officers was marked by an almost ritualistic courtesy, devoid of personal touch yet unwavering in its duty. Despite the rigid protocol, there lingered an unspoken understanding between the regulated environment and those navigating it, a shared acceptance of the measures necessary for safety. As she completed the verification process, her eyes scanned the room, noting the precise alignment of items on trays, the steady flow of people, and the unwavering presence of the officers, each a testament to the systematic nature of the checkpoint. In the corner, a display illustrated the protocols with meticulous diagrams, reinforcing the regimented approach to security. Meanwhile, another traveler, having just cleared the body scan, moved towards collecting his possessions, glancing back once before departing, a fleeting nod acknowledging the necessity of the thorough scrutiny. The room buzzed with the orchestrated movement of individuals, each step guided by the invisible hands of regulation, culminating in a seamless departure from the controlled space. Beyond the exit doors, a final sign bid farewell with an official note of reassurance, underscoring the comprehensive nature of the security checks conducted within.

At the terminal's entry, beyond the arched barriers, stood a queue where every person placed their carry-ons into clear trays awaiting scrutiny. Every passenger was asked to remove electronic devices and liquids from the plastic bins before passing them through the X-ray machine; some also had to walk through the metal detectors, their feet planted firmly on the ground as instructed. A guard selected one traveler, directing him aside towards a separate area marked by signs advising additional checks were required. The officer then requested to see his passport and boarding pass, her voice steady yet impersonal amid the bustling crowd. With the documents verified, she proceeded with a thorough search, using a handheld scanner to check for prohibited items, her gaze never wavering. Even as she patted down his coat, he maintained his composure, aware that the process was standard procedure, a routine part of security measures. She concluded her inspection with a nod, her tone unchanged, instructing him to collect his belongings from the conveyor belt where they had been scanned. Moments later, another traveler was flagged for additional screening; this time, it was a small container that triggered the alarm, necessitating further examination. Both individuals moved past with a sense of resigned acceptance, knowing the protocols were in place to ensure everyone’s safety.

At the terminal entrance, beyond the glass doors, stood a security checkpoint bustling with activity during rush hour. Passengers formed long queues, their luggage divested into plastic trays for inspection under X-ray machines. The clatter of metal detectors punctuated the air, alongside the quiet command of officers guiding travelers through the process with practiced ease. Amongst the crowd, Officer Lin singled out Mr. Wei for a closer look, his documents inspected meticulously and then a pat-down conducted with a wand to ensure compliance. The atmosphere carried an unyielding rhythm: the crisp exchange of instructions, the clear signage directing individuals, and the polite yet firm demeanor of those in charge. As another passenger was waved forward, Mr. Wei felt the weight of the scrutiny, his belongings spread across a tray now ready to proceed through the scanner, while Officer Lin returned the traveler’s documents with a courteous nod, signaling the continuation of the rigorous but necessary protocol. The corridor thrummed with urgency as travelers moved steadily towards boarding, each step marked by the structured order of the checkpoint. A few more passengers were directed aside for additional checks, their actions observed with precision, before being released to join their fellow travelers in the departure lounge. In the distance, signs pointed towards gate numbers and connecting flights, a reminder of the journey ahead for those who had completed their security clearance. With a final glance around, Mr. Wei collected his items from the conveyor belt and walked through the exit, the last barrier between him and his flight now behind him, the routine of airport security firmly established in his mind.
